_comment: Strands Audit AI Analysis + Data Profiling — all config in one place

profiling._comment_lookback: default_lookback_days: 0 = current day only, 7 = last 7 days. Override per table via table_config.<table>.profiling_lookback_days

orders_db.orders_fact._comment_date_filter: date_filter_column restricts every profiling Athena query to the given date range. profiling_lookback_days=0 means current day only; 7 means last 7 days.
orders_db.orders_fact._comment_profiling_tiers: FULL=3 Athena queries, STATS_ONLY=1, COUNT_ONLY=shared batch, SKIP=excluded

orders_db.orders_fact.description: Each region's share of daily order count is monitored via z-score against a 60-day rolling baseline stratified by day-of-week.
orders_db.orders_fact.validation_query: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*)*1.0/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS share_pct FROM orders_db.orders_fact WHERE DATE(order_date) = DATE '{run_date}' GROUP BY region
orders_db.orders_fact.how_zscore_is_computed: z_score = (today_share_pct - dow_mean) / dow_stddev  where dow_mean/stddev are computed from the same day-of-week in the last 60 days

known_seasonal_patterns.ai_instruction: If failure occurs on Saturday or Sunday AND the failing region is NORTH or SOUTH AND z_score < 4.5 → classify as FALSE_POSITIVE. Weekend order mix naturally shifts toward residential regions.
If failure day is 28–31 of any month AND the failing region is WEST → classify as FALSE_POSITIVE. B2B bulk orders concentrate in WEST at month-end.

likely_true_failure_signals: Multiple regions flagged on the same day
Failure on a Tuesday or Wednesday (no seasonal explanation)
likely_false_positive_signals: z_score between 3.0 and 3.5 on any day

orders_db.orders_fact.description: order_amount must never be NULL. A null here means revenue will be understated.
order_amount must be > 0. Zero or negative amounts indicate a calculation error.

audit_db.etl_orchestrator_audit.description: glue_job_name must never be NULL when event_type is GLUE_TRIGGER.
status column must only contain known values.
When event_type is VALIDATION, the query column must not be empty.
audit_db.etl_orchestrator_audit.condition: event_type = 'VALIDATION' AND (query IS NULL OR TRIM(query) = '')

auto_ruleset_generation._comment: Reads profiling baselines from S3 and generates SQL checks run via Athena API. FAIL rows are inserted into results_table so AuditActionAgent picks them up.

IsComplete._comment: Generate an IsComplete check when historical null% was below this threshold

IsUnique._comment: Generate uniqueness check only for columns whose historical distinct_pct > threshold

RowCount._comment: Row count must stay within ± tolerance_pct of the baseline

ColumnValues_enum._comment: For low-cardinality stable dimensions: distinct count must not expand

ColumnValues_range._comment: For numeric columns: min/max must stay within ± tolerance_pct

ZScore_distribution._comment: Z-score checks are already handled by table_rules[].validation_query — this entry is documentation only

ml_anomaly_scoring._comment: ML-based anomaly scoring on top of rule-based detectors. Requires scikit-learn (Isolation Forest) and adtk (time-series). Set enabled=true once you have min_baseline_runs of history.

isolation_forest._comment: Trains one Isolation Forest per column on historical stats features. Flags current run stats that fall outside the normal distribution.

adtk._comment: Time-series anomaly detection on metric trends across profiling runs. SeasonalAD captures day-of-week patterns automatically.

LevelShiftAD._comment: Flags sudden sustained level shifts (e.g. row_count drops by 30% and stays low)

SeasonalAD._comment: Detects deviations from day-of-week seasonality. freq=7 means weekly period.

InterquartileRangeAD._comment: Flags IQR outliers — good for metric columns where extreme spikes are the signal

natural_language_validations.query: Are there any orders where order_amount is NULL or zero for today?
Show me the top 3 regions by order count for the last 7 days and flag any region whose share dropped by more than 10 percentage points vs the prior 7 days
Are there any runs where a GLUE_TRIGGER event has no matching VALIDATION event on the same run_date?
Is the average Athena cost_usd per run trending upward over the last 14 days?

reporting._comment: HTML report is always written to output/dq_report_{date}.html. Email is sent via SMTP when enabled=true.

email.subject: [Strands DQ] Data Quality Report
email._comment_auth: Leave username/password empty for unauthenticated internal relays
email._comment_attach: Set attach_csvs=true to attach all 4 CSV files to the email
